pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)spell power, growing with the tier, up to +30%%.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 8.

Will not count without:$(li)1 of Scroll Forge$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)Scroll Forge$(li)Arcane Anvil$(li)Blood Cauldron or Alchemist Cauldron$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#arcane)any arcane$(/l)$(li)Armor Pile$(p)Counts against it:$(li)any crops$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#bookshelves)any bookshelves$(/l)
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Pedestals surrounds forge, and ground forms a contiguous platform, and light is 1-5 from forge.
